title: CodesTaskUpdatedPayload
description: codes.task.updated v1 (OpenVibe.Codes): a task's status changed. The one event the Dock's Code tab follows instead of polling: every state change writes it, alongside the per-state codes.task.* event. STATE is the announced state (placed reads as running, expired as failed). URL is the task's page on openvibe.codes. Envelope: source codes, subject { type: user, id: <owner usr_> }, visibility internal.

repo.description: owner/name from the task's repository URL, or null when it is not a repository path.
